comparison.objective: Turn a fallen humanoid face-up without trapping or rolling it onto its arm; candidate adjusts and validates a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body reorientation with limb management differs from precision tool engagement, small-part rotation, fastening, and iterative cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Humanoid must finish on its back without arm entrapment; the record omits pose, contact-force, damage, and stability thresholds. Candidate uses quantified impact limits.
comparison.reason: The tested whole-body handling ability is materially different.
